overview.description: The GraniteShares Platinum Trust (PLTM) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Disc. Platinum London PM Fix index. The fund tracks the platinum spot price, less trust expenses and liabilities, using physically held platinum. PLTM was launched on Jan 22, 2018 and is issued by GraniteShares.
